Position Summary

We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst / CDP Developer
to support enterprise Customer Data Platform (CDP) operations, improve data quality, and deliver scalable data solutions across large customer and event datasets. This role blends advanced SQL development, CDP integration, workflow orchestration, and production data troubleshooting.

The ideal candidate brings strong expertise in customer data platforms, advanced SQL engineering, Python automation, and cloud data environments
, along with experience supporting production data pipelines and customer data privacy requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Data Analysis & Development

Analyze customer data, event streams, and large-scale datasets to generate insights
Develop and optimize advanced SQL queries across Presto, Hive, and NoSQL environments
Use Python for data processing, automation, API integrations, and workflow support
Perform exploratory data analysis and anomaly detection
Document data processes, business rules, and workflows

CDP & Pipeline Operations

Support CDP workflow orchestration (Digdag, TD Workflows, or similar tools)
Monitor and enhance data quality frameworks and observability pipelines
Maintain CI/CD and Git-based version control for data code and documentation
Support end-to-end data lifecycle from ingestion to activation

Troubleshooting & Production Support

Diagnose data pipeline failures and workflow issues
Perform root cause analysis using logs and monitoring tools
Support production job monitoring, data validation, and output verification
Implement fixes and reliability improvements

Data Governance & Compliance

Ensure adherence to privacy and compliance standards (GDPR, CCPA, PII handling)
Support identity resolution, schema design, and profile unification

What You’ll Be Working On

Customer Data Platform integrations and pipeline operations
Large-scale customer and event data processing
Data quality, automation, and workflow optimization
Cross-functional data solutions supporting CRM, marketing, and analytics teams

Required Skills & Experience

Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
8+ years combined experience in data analysis, data engineering, or data operations
Advanced SQL development and query optimization (Presto, Hive, NoSQL environments)
Experience working with Customer Data Platforms and CRM data integrations
Strong Python experience for data automation and APIs
Cloud data platform familiarity (AWS preferred)
Experience with workflow orchestration tools (Digdag, TD Workflows, or similar)
Experience supporting production data environments
Experience with data quality frameworks, monitoring, and alerting
Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills

Preferred Skills

Experience with Treasure Data CDP or similar platforms (Informatica, Adobe, Salesforce CDP, Tealium, mParticle)
Experience with data modeling, identity resolution, and profile unification
Experience with CI/CD and Git-based workflows
Strong privacy and compliance experience (GDPR, CCPA, PII handling)
3+ years of Big 4 consulting experience (preferred)
Stable work history within large enterprise organizations

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
There is only one city in the country that can say it is the Nation’s Capital – Washington, D.C. Given that distinction, The Metropolitan Police Department is the premiere law enforcement organization in the city. We receive over 22 million visitors a year, have almost 700,000 residents, and 21,000 private business. The Department consists of more than 4,200 members: approximately 3,550 sworn members and over 650 civilian employees. We are one of the most diverse and highly trained departments in the country. We have the honor of safeguarding and protecting not only our nation’s residents, but also people from all over the world.

The Metropolitan Police Department (MPD) offers an attractive benefits package. The benefits package includes competitive compensation, health insurance, prescription drug coverage, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability and life insurance, as well a strong retirement benefit and savings options. Employees are also eligible for our employer contributed 401a plan after one year of employment. Additional perks such as discounts on wireless carriers, gym memberships, amusement park tickets and much more! Additional information can be found at: DCHR Benefits

This position is located in the Metropolitan Police Department (MPD), Technical and Analytical Services Bureau (TASB), Applications Management Division, Data Quality Branch. The incumbent is responsible for monitoring field reports and data stored in computer applications of varying degrees of complexity, accuracy and legibility to determine the appropriateness of initial classifications and other information.

This Data Analyst position is covered under the National Association of Government Employees (NAGE) bargaining unit and you may be required to pay an agency fee through direct payroll deductions.

The Incumbent Will Be Responsible For The Following

Examining and evaluating automated field reports and data stored in computer applications of varying degrees of complexity, accuracy and legibility to determine the appropriateness of initial classifications and other information entered by field reporting units and citizens. This may include incident reports, offense reports, traffic crash reports, arrest reports, DUI arrest reports, citizens-online reports, missing persons reports, field contact reports, etc.
Screening reports for data quality to determine that all required crime or crash related information is present in an acceptable form and secures any further information required prior to officially approving the report.
Ensuring report data quality accuracy related to codes and related fields for both crime and crash incidents.
Verifying and reclassifying, as necessary, the reports for Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) National Incident Based Reporting System (NIBRS) and Uniform Crime Reporting (UCR) Standards, as well as the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA)-Minimum Model Uniform Crash Criteria (MMUCC) Guidelines. Records any reclassifications into the relevant database/software application.
Corresponding with citizens and officers via email and/or telephone to improve the completeness and clarify of the content in their report for data quality purposes.
Maintaining records of reports that have been rejected, updated, re-coded, etc., and the reason for these actions. Providing this documentation when needed for audit purposes.
Providing more efficient methods for procedural processing. This includes testing and providing feedback on application functionality, as well as serving as a team leader in business process development.
Maintaining and consulting a reference library of: DC Code statutes; FBI, NIBRS and UCR procedures; written Departmental Directives; Teletypes; criminal arrest procedures; training guides and relevant memorandums; and Traffic Crash, Commercial Vehicles, and Citizen Online procedures.
Developing complex queries (SQL) used by reporting environments and data-driven dashboard applications, including queries and visualizations for ad-hoc requests and projects, as well as ongoing reporting.
Designing and implementing reports using MS Excel, OneDrive, R, Tableau, or other reporting tools. Using data and metrics to draw business insights, with a special focus on efficiency, easing administrative burden, improving information products and reports.
Preparing records, correspondence and reports using word processing and spreadsheet applications that assist with improving the quality and accuracy of MPD’s data.
Performing audits on statistics to ensure all information is complete and accurate, as needed.
Visiting police districts and specialized units to familiarize members with Data Quality Branch functions. Gathering requirements when districts require a new BI report to make their process more effective and efficient.
Determining whether irregularities affect the validity of the information contained in reports.
Providing on-the-job training to new or less-experienced professional or sworn members. This includes serving as a subject matter expert or “go-to” person for less senior staff needing assistance reviewing more complex reports.
Providing regular procedural and technical support of the Records Management System and responds to any sworn member, court representative or citizen requests.

new_jobs.title: Data Analyst
new_jobs.description:
There is only one city in the country that can say it is the Nation’s Capital – Washington, D.C. Given that distinction, The Metropolitan Police Department is the premiere law enforcement organization in the city. We receive over 22 million visitors a year, have almost 700,000 residents, and 21,000 private business. The Department consists of more than 4,200 members: approximately 3,550 sworn members and over 650 civilian employees. We are one of the most diverse and highly trained departments in the country. We have the honor of safeguarding and protecting not only our nation’s residents, but also people from all over the world.

The Metropolitan Police Department (MPD) offers an attractive benefits package. The benefits package includes competitive compensation, health insurance, prescription drug coverage, dental, vision, short- and long-term disability and life insurance, as well a strong retirement benefit and savings options. Employees are also eligible for our employer contributed 401a plan after one year of employment. Additional perks such as discounts on wireless carriers, gym memberships, amusement park tickets and much more! Additional information can be found at: DCHR Benefits

This position is located in the Metropolitan Police Department (MPD), Technical and Analytical Services Bureau (TASB), Applications Management Division, Data Quality Branch. The incumbent is responsible for monitoring field reports and data stored in computer applications of varying degrees of complexity, accuracy and legibility to determine the appropriateness of initial classifications and other information.

This Data Analyst position is covered under the National Association of Government Employees (NAGE) bargaining unit and you may be required to pay an agency fee through direct payroll deductions.

The Incumbent Will Be Responsible For The Following

Examining and evaluating automated field reports and data stored in computer applications of varying degrees of complexity, accuracy and legibility to determine the appropriateness of initial classifications and other information entered by field reporting units and citizens. This may include incident reports, offense reports, traffic crash reports, arrest reports, DUI arrest reports, citizens-online reports, missing persons reports, field contact reports, etc.
Screening reports for data quality to determine that all required crime or crash related information is present in an acceptable form and secures any further information required prior to officially approving the report.
Ensuring report data quality accuracy related to codes and related fields for both crime and crash incidents.
Verifying and reclassifying, as necessary, the reports for Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI) National Incident Based Reporting System (NIBRS) and Uniform Crime Reporting (UCR) Standards, as well as the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA)-Minimum Model Uniform Crash Criteria (MMUCC) Guidelines. Records any reclassifications into the relevant database/software application.
Corresponding with citizens and officers via email and/or telephone to improve the completeness and clarify of the content in their report for data quality purposes.
Maintaining records of reports that have been rejected, updated, re-coded, etc., and the reason for these actions. Providing this documentation when needed for audit purposes.
Providing more efficient methods for procedural processing. This includes testing and providing feedback on application functionality, as well as serving as a team leader in business process development.
Maintaining and consulting a reference library of: DC Code statutes; FBI, NIBRS and UCR procedures; written Departmental Directives; Teletypes; criminal arrest procedures; training guides and relevant memorandums; and Traffic Crash, Commercial Vehicles, and Citizen Online procedures.
Developing complex queries (SQL) used by reporting environments and data-driven dashboard applications, including queries and visualizations for ad-hoc requests and projects, as well as ongoing reporting.
Designing and implementing reports using MS Excel, OneDrive, R, Tableau, or other reporting tools. Using data and metrics to draw business insights, with a special focus on efficiency, easing administrative burden, improving information products and reports.
Preparing records, correspondence and reports using word processing and spreadsheet applications that assist with improving the quality and accuracy of MPD’s data.
Performing audits on statistics to ensure all information is complete and accurate, as needed.
Visiting police districts and specialized units to familiarize members with Data Quality Branch functions. Gathering requirements when districts require a new BI report to make their process more effective and efficient.
Determining whether irregularities affect the validity of the information contained in reports.
Providing on-the-job training to new or less-experienced professional or sworn members. This includes serving as a subject matter expert or “go-to” person for less senior staff needing assistance reviewing more complex reports.
Providing regular procedural and technical support of the Records Management System and responds to any sworn member, court representative or citizen requests.
Establishing and implementing effective requirements practices, including use and continuous improvement of a data requirements process and tools. Implementing ways to reuse requirements across projects.
Asking probing questions to fully understand business requirements and provide feedback to the business on the implications of requests
Quickly understanding issues and challenges faced by the business. Accurately and concisely articulates issues, risks, questions, and recommendations to customers, team members and management.
Building and maintaining highly effective relationships with all MPD teams and vendors. Ensuring relationships with the customers and cross-team members are professional and meet management expectations.
Performing other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

Knowledge in analytical and problem-solving skills, and the ability to plan long and short-term project work.
Skilled in working closely with individuals and groups to identify issues, analyze alternatives, and resolve problems
Skilled in preparing analytical reports and decision memos, identify policy or process issues, and offer multiple resolution options.
Skilled in responding to people in a tactful manner; react quickly and appropriately to requests for information; establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with MPD’s staff and others.
Knowledge of project management principles and methods.
Advanced expertise in Microsoft Excel or similar tools including BI tools. Knowledge of Cognos, Power BI and/or Tableau is preferred.
Proficient in the use of personal computers and various software, such as Microsoft Word, Microsoft Visio, and PowerPoint.
Knowledge in programming languages like SQL, analyzing and exploring the data, running queries and identifying and interpreting trends in data.
Skill in using software database applications, with specific expertise in MPD’s Records Management System (RMS).
Ability to identify issues and problems, and recommend solutions for enterprise-level initiatives.
Ability to communicate effectively both orally and in writing; prepares and presents written and oral presentations.
Ability to respond to people in a tactful manner; reacts quickly and appropriately to requests for information; establish and maintain cooperative working relationships with MPD’s staff and others.

Licensures, Certifications And Other Requirements

N/A

Education

High School Diploma or Equivalent.

Work Experience

Applicants must have at least one (1) year of specialized experience equivalent to at least the CS-11 grade level, or its non-District equivalent, gained from public or private sector. Specialized experience for this position includes, but is not limited to: understanding criminal code and procedures to conduct examination of documents and electronic records, and to code and classify reports; experience with operating various software packages and database applications to develop, maintain, and update contents and run queries to analyze data; and the ability to express and present ideas regarding complex topics through both written and oral communications.

Work Environment

Work location is in an office environment. Work is sedentary and may require walking and standing in conjunction with travel and attendance at meeting and conferences away from the work site and carrying light items, such as laptops, papers, books, small parts, and driving an automobile.

Other Significant Factors

Promotion Potential: No Known Promotion Potential

This Position Is Deemed As "Security Sensitive” Pursuant To Chapter 4 Of The D.C. Personnel Regulations, In Addition To The General Suitability Screening And Criminal Background Check (pre-employment And Periodic), Individuals May Be Subject To The Following Checks And Tests

Traffic record check (as applicable);
Pre-employment drug and alcohol test (as applicable);
Consumer credit check (as applicable);
Reasonable suspicion drug and alcohol test;
Random drug and alcohol test;
Return to duty or follow-up drug and alcohol test; and
Post-accident or incident drug and alcohol test.

The incumbent is required to possess and maintain a valid motor vehicle operator’s permit.

Sexual harassment is a form of sex discrimination, which is also prohibited. In addition, harassment based on any of the above-protected categories is prohibited.
